title: Municipal Council Chamber
purpose: City and local-government sector card and civic surfaces.
story: A municipal council chamber readied for a sitting — the modest seat of local authority, dignified and still.
environment: A horseshoe council chamber, members' desks curving toward a raised chair, a public gallery dim at the rear.
architecture: Civic-institutional interior — a panelled dado, a shallow domed ceiling, a presiding dais beneath a carved canopy.
composition: The horseshoe of desks framing the empty chair on the central axis, warm light pooling on the dais, the gallery in negative space behind.
objects: a ceremonial mace on a rest
negativeExtra: civic coats of arms with lettering
